Gravestone Project — Reconciled GM Timeline

DateEvent
350 BCFilverl Lightfoot meets Brother Salla, a traveler from the land of the Star.
345 BCFilverl records population culling at Pale or Gravestone Lake.
343–338 BCBrother Salla proposes Arniean transport of the Glades’ “excess” population; the arrangement is approved.
325 BCBrother Salla returns with Sister Rasha; Lightfoot wealth begins funding the metal-men project. The separate Star Journal attributes the laboratory effort to Sister Salla.
315–275 BCThe Gravestone laboratory is built with assistance from Dwarven engineers.
270–225 BCSisters Mira and Amala and Brother Ruben expand Shining Star influence over the project and the Lightfoot family.
215 BCSubjects from the Glades are used in attempts to create soul stones.
210 BCSuccessful stones are made from lineages influenced by Celestials.
205 BCSeveral prototypes are animated and units stationed at the estate and laboratory.
Later pre-CataclysmExcelsior production facilities assemble battle and war golems. Illusion-concealed forces attack Kergrin and are ultimately driven back.
843 AC eraThe modern SSP has rediscovered enough technology to resume war-golem production after acquiring a soul stone from the party.

Open questions: the relationship between Brother and Sister Salla; the relationship, if any, between Sister Amara and Lady Amara Grethry; the complete Excelsior corporate or governmental structure; and the exact date of the Gravestone facility letter.
